mix: High-contrast comedy mix (-13.3 LUFS, LRA 4.9 LU from hard music mutes, +0.3 dBTP) with 46.6% sub-bass (<80 Hz, Vine booms peaking at -6.2 dB RMS) and crisp upfront TTS voices.
why_the_sound_works: Hard-muting the BGM on key beats (0:02.4, 0:06.1-0:12.9, 0:26.4-0:28.4) doubles punchline impact.
Using deep 'Adam' baritone both with hall echo for Mom (0:06.2) and bone-dry for the son (0:26.7) makes vocal timbre the joke.
Spot foley every ~1.5s (keyboard + giggle 0:04.0, glass crash 0:16.9, snicker 0:18.4, aura 0:24.1) locks attention.
Teleport-pop vanish at 0:30.7 in the opening hallway loops seamlessly back into 0:00.1 'Bro!'.
